_about: OWNER file. mode: observe (the .3mf writer only reports) or enforce (it refuses a new mesh without a valid stamp, and a fit setting changed unasked). not_printed: regex on a component or body name; a match is not a printed part. targets: what each .3mf project prints with, keyed by its key in gate/layout.json: nozzle, line width, material, and the slicer settings every fit is measured under (layer_height, initial_layer_print_height, xy_hole_compensation, xy_contour_compensation, elefant_foot_compensation, wall_generator). gate.py verify compares the project file with them; a fit measured under other values counts as not printed. An object that is meant to print with another value is declared too, under "objects" of its target: {"objects": {"<object name>": {"layer_height": 0.2}}}; an override that is not declared is a finding.
